toolsPreview.name: access_check
toolsPreview.description: Loss-leader URL access, login, and CAPTCHA check. Price: $0.05 USDC. Example: GET /v1/access-check?url=https://example.com

toolsPreview.name: api_discovery
toolsPreview.description: Discover OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, MCP, and API documentation signals. Price: $0.10 USDC. Example: GET /v1/api-discovery?url=https://example.com

toolsPreview.name: change_check
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a URL and compare its content fingerprint with the prior KV observation. Price: $0.10 USDC. Example: POST /v1/change-check

toolsPreview.name: preflight
toolsPreview.description: Single-fetch URL intelligence, access checks, commerce signals, and risk. Price: $0.15 USDC. Example: GET /v1/preflight?url=https://example.com&intent=research

toolsPreview.name: product_intel
toolsPreview.description: Extract product price, availability, add-to-cart, and commerce risk signals. Price: $0.15 USDC. Example: GET /v1/product-intel?url=https://example.com

toolsPreview.name: batch_preflight
toolsPreview.description: Run standard preflight against as many as 10 URLs in one paid request. Price: $0.35 USDC. Example: POST /v1/batch-preflight

toolsPreview.name: premium_preflight
toolsPreview.description: Triple-user-agent intelligence with five-hop redirect evidence, retries, access controls, commerce risk, can_proceed, and proof. Price: $0.75 USDC. Example: GET /v1/premium-preflight?url=https://example.com
